ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. Enrollment in this section is restricted to non-residential, non-degree seeking students. Degree-seeking UIUC students should register for sections without this restriction. Enrollment in this blended, online and on-campus course section is restricted to off-campus, nondegree student only. LER 410 AO1 is a hybrid course and is taught online through Compass but also requires six in class sessions. In class sessions will be determined by the instructor after the start of the semester in consultation with the entire class. Residential student are expected to enroll in the On-Campus section CRN: 57817.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $362.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $325.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
